summary: 'We the Travellers – I' develops mathematical reasoning and application through the chapter 'We the Travellers – I'. The main learning is organised around the source-supported points below.
key_points: We the Travellers — I When was the last time you went on a long trip?
Ask the elders who went with you to help you answer these questions.
Human beings have always been interested in travelling.
About a hundred years ago, there were far fewer vehicles than today.
There were animal-drawn carts, cars, and trains.
Long before this, thousands of years ago, people travelled long distances on foot or used animals to travel from one place to another.
